name: Staged: MINNEN on the left wall with the TROFAST along its foot, desk in the window corner with BESTÅ storage above
notes:
Staged pick, re-reviewed 2026-10-23 for F-63 and re-planned the same day for F-31's 36" landings, after Andrew asked of the TROFAST on the closet doors' arc: "why would a storage be put right in front of the door like this?" The bed, dresser, desk and BESTÅ unit stay. The floor in front of the door and the closet (y 86-122) is now open: the TROFAST moves to the bed's open side, and the book display, which stood 2.5" past the door's arc, comes off the plan because no wall is left for it. 12 placed, 9 extras.
bed-1 MINNEN (fully extended, 77.5"), head on the top wall, long side on the left wall, flush (IKEA: under 2 1/2" or over 9" from a wall): F-34 open side clear for 24" between the dresser and the TROFAST and 41" out to the desk chair; the TROFAST runs along its foot half; F-33 bedding 71.5" from the heater face.
dresser-1 GODISHUS 3-drawer beside the bed's head as the bedside table (23 5/8" high): F-32 24" in front to the TROFAST's end, 41" to the desk chair; F-21 anchor it (IKEA: "must be securely anchored").
desk-1 FLISAT on the top wall in the window corner: F-33 right end 6" from the heater face; F-35 30" chair zone clear behind it (y 25.6 to 55.6), the chair 19.5" from the heater, not backed against a heater wall; 3 1/8" from the dresser. chair-1 SUNDVIK pulled out at the desk ("Last chance" at IKEA: buy it with the desk).
cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 47 1/4x16 1/2x15" (top, new): top wall above the desk, x 58.75-106, its right end 6" short of the heater face (F-33): closed storage hung above her reach for markers, paint, glue and rotation toys a parent hands down (F-63): solid LAPPVIKEN doors (no glass, F-21), hung on 2 BESTÅ suspension rails screwed into studs (extras), underside about 54" up. The canvas art moves off this wall to make room.
toys-1 TROFAST along the bed's open side, rot 270, x 40.5-57.9, y 40.9-77.5: its back to the bed rail, its end flush with the bed's foot, the boxes facing the play floor. F-32 54" in front of the boxes to the heater face; F-31 44.5" from the closet doors and 8.5" clear of the closet's and the door's 36" landings; F-33 54" from the heater face, with no slot beside the heater. Her books stand face out on its top, within reach of the bed. Making the bed means reaching over it at the foot.
rug-1 VALLABY road-map rug, rot 0, x 61-100, y 40-92: the play floor in front of the TROFAST, 12" from the heater face (F-33), clear of the desk chair and the TROFAST, so nothing stands on its edge; its last 6" lie in the closet's landing, 2.5" short of the doors' arc.
canopy-1 LÖVA on the top wall over the bed's head (the bed is the reading nook, the TROFAST's books at hand); mount it out of her reach (IKEA). lamp-1 UPPLYST on the left wall over the bed as her reading light, cord fastened to the wall (IKEA). nightlight-1 TÖVÄDER and plant-1 FEJKA (artificial) on the dresser. art-1 BLODFLÄDER (canvas, no glass, F-21) on the left wall at the bed's foot, at her eye level, 1.5" clear of the open door.
Maddie is 4 (F-21): every piece within her reach is under 27" or anchored (the GODISHUS carries IKEA's anchor warning at 23 5/8", so it is anchored too); no glass anywhere; no loft or bunk.
Walkways (F-30): the 36" landings in front of the door and the closet are open floor (F-31); door to room along them and up past the TROFAST's end, 44.5" below it; bed to desk 41"; bed to door around the TROFAST's end.
Extras: VIMSIG mattress and BARNDRÖM fitted sheet in the frame, SMÅSPORRE insert, BARNDRÖM cover, low pillow, SKOGSDUVA cushions x2, BENGTA panel (cut to clear the heater, F-33) on the HUGAD rod (assumed-position:window), BESTÅ suspension rails x2. Not placed: the FLISAT book display ikea-80614566 (above).
Total $1,159.31: placed $787.89 + extras $371.42; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
Audit 2026-10-24 (from the rug-free E): two safety lines. The desk ends 12" from the window wall beside the window and her chair is a step onto it, so fit window stops or guards before move-in (not in the catalog; the sill is unmeasured, F-38). Standing on the desk she can open the BESTÅ cabinet hung above it, so give it a child lock or keep only washable, non-toxic supplies in it.
